data.gender_notes: Mangala is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Goddess Mangala is the goddess of wealth, prosperity, and good fortune in Hindu mythology. She is also known as the goddess of fertility and protector of marriage and children. The name Mangala carries the meaning “Auspicious, Fortunate” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Mangala usually hope their child will grow to embody auspicious, fortunate and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes good luck, abundance, and auspiciousness.
data.etymology: Mangala belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Auspicious, Fortunate.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mangala total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Mangala" is believed to bring good luck and prosperity in various aspects of life. In Hindu weddings, the bride and groom are often blessed by the goddess Mangala, symbolizing the arrival of abundance, happiness, and harmony in their newly wedded life. The name is frequently used as a prefix to the names of girls in India, reflecting the cultural belief that a child with such a name will be blessed with good fortune and happiness.
data.spiritual_significance: In Hinduism, the name "Mangala" holds significant spiritual importance as it is associated with the goddess Mangala, who embodies the qualities of abundance, prosperity, good luck, and protection. The name serves as a reminder of the divine presence of the deity and helps instill a sense of trust and belief in her powers and blessings. It is believed that invoking the energy of the goddess Mangala can bring positive changes in one's life and help overcome various challenges and obstacles.
